name: bandit.all_light_source_live_adapter_mcw
status: green scenario / Slice 5 horde retarget-persistence proof (no local devirtualization claim)
description: Slice 5 all-light-source live adapter proof route: load the staged all-light fixture, audit saved fire/smoke/furniture/portable-item/household-item light and staged ground-z horde footing, run a bounded in-game wait through the real wait UI, require same-run live signal logs for smoke plus multiple exposed light packets, guard the post-wait save prompt/writeback, then inspect saved turn/weather and overmap horde destination/tracking metadata from the completed saved state. The fixture and run explicitly keep player/horde footing on ground z=0; local/reality-bubble zombie devirtualization is not claimed here.

steps.label: all_light_source_load_settle
steps.expected_visible_fact: loaded McWilliams gameplay screen from the all-light staged fixture; startup/load is footing only before saved metadata, live wait artifacts, save/writeback, weather audit, and horde metadata prove the slice

steps.label: audit_saved_all_light_source_footing_before_wait
steps.abort_reason: saved map metadata did not contain the staged fd_fire/fd_smoke/f_exodii_lamp/torch_lit/smart_lamp_on source mix before the bounded live wait
steps.expected_visible_fact: same-save metadata contains separate fire, smoke, furniture-light, portable torch-light, and household smart-lamp sources before any live signal credit

steps.label: audit_saved_weather_before_all_light_wait
steps.expected_visible_fact: saved dimension weather metadata is recorded before the live wait so the log weather/source interpretation can be compared to actual saved clear weather state

steps.label: audit_saved_turn_before_all_light_wait
steps.expected_visible_fact: saved player turn baseline is recorded before the bounded all-light live wait

steps.label: audit_saved_horde_before_all_light_wait
steps.abort_reason: saved overmap horde_map metadata did not contain the idle staged mon_zombie horde before the bounded live wait
steps.expected_visible_fact: same-save overmap metadata contains the staged idle ground-z horde before the light/smoke signal has a chance to retarget it

steps.label: operate_all_light_source_live_adapter
steps.objective: From the bound World surface, use only advertised native owners to open world.wait, choose the current five-minute duration owner, collect the accepted receipt and successor World frame, then retain the same-run source/horde log and save evidence before sealing the run.
proof_targets: loaded fire, smoke, furniture and portable light footing
accepted world.wait -> duration owner -> five-minute native receipt
successor World turn delta of at least five minutes
same-run light-interest log and saved horde processing metadata
authority: advertised native actions and their currently advertised duration owners
invariants: no debug signal, horde, target-knowledge or save mutation
fixture installation and audits are footing, not live proof
the light cue does not identify a player or other entity

steps.label: advance_five_minutes_for_current_light_sample
steps.objective: Advance the ordinary five-minute native wait transaction so the loaded-source sample has an honest hostile scheduler cadence without player movement or raw-key dispatch.
steps.abort_reason: the native five-minute wait transaction did not complete into a fresh world frame; do not credit all-light live proof without completed in-game elapsed-time footing
steps.expected_visible_fact: a native semantic five-minute wait runs from loaded gameplay into a fresh world frame, and same-run debug artifacts show the current shared light sample and horde interest

steps.label: audit_all_light_source_signal_artifacts
steps.abort_reason: same-run debug artifact did not contain the all-light/smoke live signal scan plus horde-light signal lines after the bounded wait
steps.expected_visible_fact: same-run debug artifact contains live smoke plus four non-fire/fire light packets, raw weather/light-weather logging, and the current light-specific horde-interest metadata

steps.label: audit_player_save_mtime_before_all_light_save
steps.expected_visible_fact: saved-player file mtime baseline is recorded after the bounded all-light wait/log gate and before the guarded save/writeback request

steps.label: request_direct_save_after_all_light_signal_wait
steps.expected_visible_fact: Save command is requested after the bounded all-light wait; the following uppercase-Y confirmation plus mtime/state gates prove completed writeback

steps.label: confirm_direct_save_after_all_light_signal_wait
steps.expected_visible_fact: uppercase Y confirms the recorded save prompt after the bounded all-light wait; following mtime and saved-state gates prove same-run writeback

steps.label: audit_player_save_mtime_after_all_light_save
steps.abort_reason: saved-player file mtime did not advance after confirming the all-light post-wait save
steps.expected_visible_fact: saved-player file mtime advanced after the confirmed all-light post-wait save, proving the following turn/weather/horde audits read same-run persisted state

steps.label: audit_saved_turn_after_all_light_wait
steps.abort_reason: saved player turn counter did not advance by the five-minute exposure window
steps.expected_visible_fact: post-sample saved player turn counter advanced by at least five minutes, proving the shared advancing-turn sample persisted

steps.label: audit_saved_weather_after_all_light_wait
steps.expected_visible_fact: same-run saved dimension clear-weather metadata is readable after the all-light wait/save and can be compared with the raw_weather/light_weather values logged by the live adapter

steps.label: audit_saved_horde_after_all_light_signal_wait
steps.abort_reason: saved overmap horde_map metadata did not show the staged ground-z mon_zombie horde still nearby with a post-baseline processing timestamp after the live horde signal
steps.expected_visible_fact: same-run saved overmap horde_map metadata shows the staged ground-z mon_zombie horde stayed nearby and processed after the baseline turn; exact destination remains review metadata because the live horde-light log carries the source-selection proof

proof_contract.claim: Prove the Slice 5 live loaded-map adapter observes staged fire, smoke, furniture light, portable item light, and household smart-lamp light; logs weather/source interpretation; delivers exposed light pressure to hordes; and leaves saved horde destination/tracking metadata inspectable after a bounded real wait path.
proof_contract.current_wip_blocker: resolved by requiring ground-z staged horde footing plus saved overmap destination/last_processed persistence after the bounded wait; local active-monster devirtualization remains outside this Slice 5 checkpoint.
proof_contract.load_only_verdict: load proof only / inconclusive for all-light-source live adapter response
proof_contract.failure_rule: No Slice 5 live proof credit if source metadata, live wait, same-run signal artifacts, save prompt/writeback, post-wait saved turn/weather audit, or saved horde destination/processing metadata is missing or non-green.
